title: 6th special sitting of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/2025/20/ޚޞ/6).

Report of the Independent Institutions Committee on the President's submission to appoint the President and Vice President of the Civil Service Commission under Article 17(c) of Law No. 5/2007 (Civil Service Act).

Report of the Human Rights and Gender Committee on the President's submission to appoint the Vice President of the Human Rights Commission of the Maldives under Article 8(c) of Law No. 6/2006 (Human Rights Commission Act).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: A special afternoon sitting called to take committee reports on the President's nominees for Civil Service Commission leadership and the Human Rights Commission vice presidency and vote on them.
